title: Two Pairs of Footsteps, Falling Out of Step

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
One day off, while strolling through town without any particular destination,
I caught sight of a familiar figure.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Oh? My goodness, Trainer.
Good day to you, what a lovely coincidence~.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Yes~... Oh, that reminds me.
Trainer, if you have some free time——

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Would you care to accompany me to the amusement park~?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
My father was kind enough to give me a pair of tickets,
yet I had completely forgotten about their expiration date~...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe. Embarrassingly enough, if I hadn't run into you,
one of the pair would have gone completely to waste~.
choice_data_list: Come to think of it, your father...
Come to think of it, doesn't your father...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Yes, he is the owner of a theme park.
So you see, I am quite accustomed to places like this~.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Therefore...
Oh my, isn't this a wonderful opportunity?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe. Today, I shall give you
a proooper escort~♪

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Saying so, Mejiro Bright uncharacteristically took the lead
to show me around the theme park.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
My, the wait for this attraction... is a whole hour, isn't it.
Hmm, isn't that a little bit too long?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Trainer,
let us go take a look at another attraction~.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Mejiro Bright changed her plans because she was watching the clock...?!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Oh my, a 120-minute wait...
A 120-minute wait means two whole hours, doesn't it~?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
It is a pity, but let us pass on this one as well~.
After all, a two-hour wait is twice as long as the previous one~.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Oh, this one is three hours... When one actually
pays attention, amusement park wait times are quite long, aren't they~?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
There were attractions we could ride if we just queued up,
but Mejiro Bright moved from one spot to the next as if purposely dodging them.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Enjoying an amusement park briskly and efficiently...
It is truly quite difficult, isn't it~? Now then, next is—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Trainer! Look over there!
That attraction only has a 15-minute wait, it seems~!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Neither of us realized at that moment,
however, why that attraction had such a short wait—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Clack... clack... clack... clack...)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Here it comes~... Here it comes, indeed~...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (KER-THUNK...!)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (WHOOOOOOSH!!)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: My goodness~ We are falling~.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The ride we boarded was the "Grand Spiral: Raging Inferno Tour."
Scream machines are usually quite popular, but—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—with reviews like "destroyed my inner ear" and "legit knocked me out,"
this one was so terrifying that people actively steered clear of it.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
After surviving that harrowing ordeal...
I had to collapse onto a nearby bench to catch my breath.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Are you all right, Trainer?
My, your eyes are spinning round and round, aren't they~?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, I thought that if I acted more prompt and brisk,
it would make the outing more enjoyable for you, but...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
You seem somehow far more exhausted than usual.
Whatever could be the reason~?
choice_data_list: I really am having fun, though.
I'm having a great time, honestly.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I told her that there was no need to rush—just strolling
through the park and chatting together was plenty of fun in itself.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Is that... truly so~?
choice_data_list: Let's take it easy and ride that one next.
Why don't we go take a slow ride on that one next?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
That one...? Ah~ The Ferris wheel.
However, the wait is an hour and a half, you know~?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
If we ride that, our day will come to an end right after.
Are you quite certain you would like to do that~?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
When I nodded, she looked as if she wanted to say something more—
but stopped herself, and joined the queue for the Ferris wheel.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
The sun has set completely, hasn't it~?
Oh, but do look! The park lights have all turned on—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
It is... ab-so-lute-ly beautiful, isn't it~?
From high atop the Ferris wheel, you can see the en-ti-re park.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Fufu... There are people boarding that scream machine from earlier~.
And just beyond that, the parade is about to depart.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Everyone looks to be having such a wonderful time.
Every corner of this place is brimming with delightful things~.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Yes, truly.
Naturally, that includes me as well...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Trainer.
Thank you ever so much for today~.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
As I suspected... acting as an escort is quite difficult~.
In the end, deciding to ride the Ferris wheel was your idea, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Even so... thanks to you, I had such an ex-qui-site-ly
wonderful time today, you know?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
...Fufu. Even if we stumble a little bit along the way...
as long as we are together, everything works out in the end.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Now then, shall we head home?
It has gotten rather late, but since we are together, we will be just fine.
choice_data_list: I'm not so sure about dorm curfew, though...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: If we apologize together, I am sure it will all be well~.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
We did end up getting a small scolding from the dorm head afterwards...
but all in all, the two of us shared a wonderful day off together!
